title: Body Composition Measurement in Conscious Mice
author: Louise Lantier
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yypfxvn
materials: Open the Minispec software. (If a popup window appears about Opus, click OK. The window should temporarily show the Opus software, then switch back to Minispec.)

steps.title: Initialize Software
steps.instruction: Log in to the system and prepare the measurement session.

substeps.instruction: Log in with the user name and password provided by MMPC staff.
Click on 'Measure'.
Perform the Daily Check with the Daily Check Sample if prompted.

steps.title: Configure Sample and Calibration
steps.instruction: Set up the batch and sample identification in the software.

substeps.instruction: Enter a Sample Batch name or choose one from the dropdown menu.
Select the calibration file from the dropdown menu (only one choice).
Enter the sample name (must start with a letter, no dash, underscores are acceptable).
Optionally enter the mouse body weight in the Comment field without letters to allow the software to calculate % Fat and % Lean.

steps.title: Prepare and Measure Mouse
steps.instruction: Position the mouse in the analyzer and execute the measurement.

substeps.instruction: Weigh the mouse and place it in the body comp clear plastic tube.
Place the plunger above the mouse.
Place the tube in the Mini Spec Body Composition Analyzer.
Click on 'Measure'.
Wait for the measurement to complete (~2min).

steps.title: Post-Measurement Handling
steps.instruction: Remove the subject and prepare for the next sample.

substeps.instruction: Remove the mouse and place it back in its cage.
Click on 'Next Sample' (bottom left) and enter a new Sample name to repeat the measurement process.

steps.title: Export Data and Exit
steps.instruction: Save the experimental results and close the software.

substeps.instruction: Click on 'View Results' (bottom left).
Click 'Export to Excel'.
Save the data on the desktop and exit the software.
Transfer the data file to a flashdrive.

steps.title: Clean Equipment
steps.instruction: Sanitize the hardware components used during the procedure.

substeps.instruction: Wash the tube and plunger in Sterilant solution.
Rinse with water and set to dry.
